Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In to Post-Adoption: Move sign-in step to occur after pet selection and certificate creation, right before waiting screen. (why: Sign-in has high early drop-off (72.9%) and delays time-to-value; letting users pick their pet first increases investment before asking for sign-in.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick-Guide Screen Before Finish: Insert a dedicated new desktop controls guide screen before final launch to teach hotkeys and visibility settings. (why: Multiple support emails reported post-setup confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Detailed Wait Progress & Time Estimate Indicator: Add step progress indicators and desktop readiness system checks to the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step drop-off is high and mean duration is 2336s, causing user drop-out and support queries about missing desktop pets.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Save Security Copy on Sign-In Screen: Update sign-in headline and body to highlight account cloud saving and instant pet restoration. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Hints for Custom Pet Upload: Add clear photo uploading tips and lighting suggestions on upload_photos screen. (why: Support mailbox received bug reports that pet creation fails or looks distorted, contributing to 60.9% adoption conversion.)
5: [finish, notification] System Tray Notification Toggle on Home Intro: Add desktop system tray hint and notification toggle on home_intro screen. (why: Finish stage drops 35.2% of users; clarifying desktop background availability reassures users the app is running.)
